description: Retrieve cross-database references for a gene or feature — HGNC, UniProt, EntrezGene, OMIM, RefSeq, Reactome, and others. Returns each xref with its database name, primary ID, display ID, and description. By default only the requested object level is queried; all_levels=true includes transcript and translation references for a gene. The dbname filter narrows this scope. IDs returned here chain to protein (pubchem via UniProt), literature (pubmed via PubMed IDs), disease (OMIM via MIM_GENE), and pathway (Reactome) resources. Requires an Ensembl stable ID — use ensembl_lookup_gene to get the ENSG… ID first. Common dbname values: HGNC, Uniprot_gn, EntrezGene, MIM_GENE, RefSeq_mRNA, RefSeq_peptide, Reactome_gene (gene pathways), Reactome (translation pathways), GO (Gene Ontology), ChEMBL.

all_levels.description: Include references on child objects: a gene includes its transcripts and translations. Default false queries only the requested object level, independently of dbname.

dbname.description: Filter to a specific external database by its Ensembl internal name. Examples: HGNC (HGNC gene ID), Uniprot_gn (UniProt gene name), EntrezGene (NCBI Gene ID), MIM_GENE (OMIM disease gene), RefSeq_mRNA (NCBI RefSeq transcript), Reactome_gene (gene pathways), Reactome (translation pathways), GO (Gene Ontology terms). Transcript/translation references may require all_levels=true or the specific feature ID. Omit to return every database within the selected scope.

id.description: Ensembl stable gene (ENSG…), transcript (ENST…), or translation (ENSP…) ID. A version suffix on an ENS… ID (ENSG00000139618.17) is dropped before the request. Use ensembl_lookup_gene to get the stable ID from a gene symbol. References default to this object level; all_levels=true includes child objects.

name: ensembl_get_xrefs

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The Ensembl stable ID was not found. An empty cross-reference list remains successful. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no cross-references are found.

queriedId.description: The Ensembl stable ID as submitted, including any version suffix.

xrefs.description: Cross-database references for the queried Ensembl ID.

items.description: A single cross-database reference entry with database name, primary ID, and description.

dbname.description: Database name in Ensembl internal format (e.g. HGNC, Uniprot_gn, EntrezGene, MIM_GENE, RefSeq_mRNA).

displayId.description: Display identifier — often the same as primaryId but may be a formatted accession.

primaryId.description: Primary identifier in the external database (e.g. HGNC:1101 for BRCA2 in HGNC, P51587 for BRCA2 in UniProt).

title: Get Cross-Database References
